subject: The confession about what happens after 30 days
preview_text: I tracked two couples for a month. One used SoulPlan, the other didn't. The difference was heartbreaking.
body_paragraphs: Okay, I need to confess something. I watched two real couples for 30 days. One used SoulPlan. The other said they'd 'figure it out themselves.' I wasn't prepared for how stark the contrast would be.

The 'figure it out' couple? By day 13, they were back to 'Netflix and takeout' and that quiet resentment when neither feels seen. By day 30, date night was a forgotten language. The SoulPlan couple? By day 13, they had a secret wishlist building. By day 30, they had a history of 8 new memories—from a budget-friendly stargazing picnic to a surprise salsa class one partner planned. Their spark wasn't just alive; it had kindling.

The difference wasn't magic. It was the Date History feature. The 'with' couple could see their shared joy timeline. The 'without' couple only saw a calendar of sameness. That visual proof of effort—of not repeating boring dates—is what builds connection.

Don't let your next 30 days be the 'without' story. Open the app right now and tap 'Date History.' See what you've built or what's missing. It's the most honest mirror for your relationship. P.S. The 'without' couple? They downloaded the app after seeing the other couple's Date History screen. The truth hurts, but it also heals.
